3220.title: Intermediate Claude request context is not emitted
3220.rootCauseOneLine: Assistant translation stores valid request-context usage but only result translation emits the context-window delta.
3220.proposedFix: Emit a context-window delta for valid top-level assistant request samples while retaining final-result capacity refinement.
3220.caveats: The verified reproduction is an exact translator and delta-assembler test; no paid live-provider process was required.
